notes.title: Pizza Master VR Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881348/7614b77778fefb6cf8fc59efc930ca22d1eb41b4.png
We'd like to celebrate the release of our latest update, which involves a series of fixes and refinements:

 We've ported the entire input system to the new Unity Input System, so now controllers should be fully supported with no bug. That means no more sprint bugs!
 Lower mouse sensitivity as the waiter. No more dizzying gameplay.
 Brand new menu screen to suit the game more
 Lots of UI refinements, i.e font's and coloring
 Plenty of optimizations! On our system, GPU headroom increased from 20% before to 80%

We're also excited to announce further progress on the Zombie mode. While it is not finished yet, many of the visuals and animations have been created, and you will be able to check it out if you please(but the gameplay is very broken at the moment.)
More news and videos of the gameplay will be posted next week.

We have also ported the entire game to a different VR SDK, for it to support the Quest, as we are planning to bring the game there in the future. However, this means the game may not work anymore for some headsets, so please let us know. 

Also, expect some spooky little changes to suit the season.

Best,
Pizza Master Team

notes.title: Major Update Now Out - Shop, Themes, Customer Packs, Gameplay, Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey Pizza Chefs,

First of all we just want to say we're sorry about the lack of activity we've had these past few months. While we had clear plans of updating the game, as you saw in the last announcement, these plans were quickly cut down by the pandemic. Due to a country lockdown, restrictions, personal events, and having no access to a VR headset or our workplace, it really destroyed our motivation to work in those months.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881348/b76be1867bae417a65d79009641fa14f8399281f.png
However, we were lucky enough to live in a country where the virus was properly managed, and two weeks ago the lockdown was lifted. As soon as it ended, we worked hard to follow through with the update we talked about months ago, and now, two weeks later we are ready to release it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881348/067872dc26009c8b7d69a8c76746d809c1bb464b.png

Here's a summary of things that have been added:

 A shop system, where you can earn coins to buy items
 Three new themes you can buy, Invasion, Winter and Spring. Once bought, each theme is available for both the singleplayer and co-op mode. You buy them with ingame money. Each theme has its own unique OST to accompany it.
 Three new customer packs you can buy, aliens, elves and animal people.
 Settings menu for options such as Master Volume, Graphics Level, Music Volume, and SFX Volume.
 Quality of life improvements, such as a ingame star meter so you can see how many stars you will earn before the end of level. We noticed a lot of people writing about how they didn't understand how to earn stars, so we thought this was a must have feature.
 New achievements for buying each item.
 A new gates system, where you have to earn a certain number of stars in one gate before you can go to the next. This is to add more challenge to the game, so that you can't just speed through the game with one star on each level.
 New icons for the arcade machine GUI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881348/ee0f65196cc216016d204fbda9ee0962311025ff.png
This is definitely not the end of what we are planning, we just thought this was a good point to release what we have done so far.
Next week and beyond we plan on doing the following:

 More levels
 Mouse sensitivity option for the waiter
 Remote play
 Fixing the infinite mode leaderboard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881348/0f13c313fab45b5f9b912a1ad7b358c21807a078.png
Also, for those who have an Oculus, we will be making an official port to the Oculus Store once our headset arrives, which is apparently due on the 20th.

Anyway, thanks for reading, we hope everyone is doing well as the virus really can affect you, even if indirectly. We plan on working hard to bring out more updates, stay tuned.
And of course, if you have any suggestions on what you would like added, please make sure to comment down below!

Kind Regards,
Plectrum Software

notes.title: Controller Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

A lot of the players requested controller support for the co-op mode, so we worked on adding XBOX controller compatibility. It is confirmed to be working now, which is great.
We want to make the game compatible with the Steam Controller too, but we don't have one, so if someone could help us test if it works that would be great.

Anyhow, for those who prefer to use a controller over mouse and keyboard, we think you will enjoy the new update, because we certainly do.
While this is a small update, much bigger ones are in the works, keep an eye out!

Thanks for reading,
Plectrum Software

notes.title: First week update: bug fixes and feedback implementation
notes.notes:
Hey Pizza Chefs!

It's the first week of release, and I can't express how awesome it is to see people playing the game, and most of all, how much feedback we have received. 
We are passionate about developing the game into something you want, and we really do care about what you think, so we collated the first week's worth of feedback and made a small update addressing a few of the issues/bugs reported.

 Ice cubes can now be placed into the cup without there being any liquid first. Before we made it so that you could only put in ice cubes after you filled the cup with a drink, but a lot of players did the complete opposite. As a result we decided to implement what the players  found intuitive.  
 Arrow keys can now be used for movement by the waiter in co-op mode. Before, only WASD was available, and some of the feedback explained that it was harder for children to understand.
 The height can now be raised by a lot more, so now even tall people can enjoy the game!
 The knife physics should be fixed, for those who had an issue with it, and so should be easier to use.
 The arcade touch screen in the menu should be a lot more responsive now.
 Some of the players seemed to accidentally press the buttons in the pop up menu without intending to, so now you have to hover over them and actually press the trigger for them to register, rather than just touching them.


Anyway, hope you guys enjoy this small update, we'll be all ears listening to any feedback you have next and will be planning a bigger content update. Keep up the constructive criticism, it is really helpful to us!

-Plectrum Software
